object.name: Object
object.short: Everything a Python program manipulates: it has an identity (address), a type, and a value.
object.def: Everything a Python program manipulates: it has an identity (address), a type, and a value. Names refer to objects; they do not contain them.

binding.name: Binding
binding.short: Associating a name with an object.
binding.def: Associating a name with an object. Assignment rebinds a name; it never copies the object.

aliasing.name: Aliasing
aliasing.short: Two or more names referring to the same object, so a mutation through one is visible through all.
aliasing.def: Two or more names referring to the same object, so a mutation through one is visible through all.

mutability.name: Mutability
mutability.short: Whether an object's value can change in place.
mutability.def: Whether an object's value can change in place. Lists, dicts, sets and tensors are mutable; ints, strings and tuples are not.

shallow-copy.name: Shallow copy
shallow-copy.short: A new container whose elements are the same objects as the original's.
shallow-copy.def: A new container whose elements are the same objects as the original's. Nested containers remain shared.

exception.name: Exception
exception.short: Python's error channel: an object raised to unwind the stack until a matching except clause catches it.
exception.def: Python's error channel: an object raised to unwind the stack until a matching except clause catches it.

jsonl.name: JSONL
jsonl.short: A text file with one JSON value per line.
jsonl.def: A text file with one JSON value per line. Blank lines are skipped by convention but still count as physical lines.

generator.name: Generator
generator.short: A function with yield, or an expression in parentheses, that produces values on demand and keeps nothing it has already produced.
generator.def: A function with yield, or an expression in parentheses, that produces values on demand and keeps nothing it has already produced.

dataclass.name: Dataclass
dataclass.short: A class whose __init__, __repr__ and __eq__ are generated from its annotated fields by the @dataclass decorator.
dataclass.def: A class whose __init__, __repr__ and __eq__ are generated from its annotated fields by the @dataclass decorator.

type-hint.name: Type hint
type-hint.short: An annotation such as list[str] that documents an intended type.
type-hint.def: An annotation such as list[str] that documents an intended type. Python does not enforce it at run time.

shape.name: Shape
shape.short: The tuple of sizes along each axis of an array or tensor.
shape.def: The tuple of sizes along each axis of an array or tensor. (2, 5, 768) means 2 items, 5 positions, 768 features.

axis.name: Axis
axis.short: One dimension of an array, numbered from 0.
axis.def: One dimension of an array, numbered from 0. Negative numbers count from the end; axis -1 is the last.

dtype.name: dtype
dtype.short: The element type of an array or tensor, such as float32, float16 or int64.
dtype.def: The element type of an array or tensor, such as float32, float16 or int64. It decides precision, memory, and which operations are allowed together.

view.name: View
view.short: A tensor or array that shares storage with another.
view.def: A tensor or array that shares storage with another. Writing through a view changes the base.

contiguous.name: Contiguous
contiguous.short: Laid out in memory in row-major order with no gaps.
contiguous.def: Laid out in memory in row-major order with no gaps. Transposes and some slices are not; .view needs contiguity, .reshape copies when needed.

broadcasting.name: Broadcasting
broadcasting.short: The rule that lets arrays of different shapes combine: align shapes at the right; each pair of sizes must be equal or one of them 1.
broadcasting.def: The rule that lets arrays of different shapes combine: align shapes at the right; each pair of sizes must be equal or one of them 1.

keepdims.name: keepdims
keepdims.short: A reduction option that keeps the reduced axis with size 1 so the result still broadcasts against the input.
keepdims.def: A reduction option that keeps the reduced axis with size 1 so the result still broadcasts against the input.

reduction.name: Reduction
reduction.short: An operation such as sum, mean or max that removes one or more axes by combining values along them.
reduction.def: An operation such as sum, mean or max that removes one or more axes by combining values along them.

einsum.name: einsum
einsum.short: Einstein-summation notation: a string names each operand's axes with letters; letters missing from the output are summed over.
einsum.def: Einstein-summation notation: a string names each operand's axes with letters; letters missing from the output are summed over.

tensor.name: Tensor
tensor.short: PyTorch's n-dimensional array, with a dtype, a device, and optional autograd tracking.
tensor.def: PyTorch's n-dimensional array, with a dtype, a device, and optional autograd tracking.

device.name: Device
device.short: Where a tensor lives: cpu, or an accelerator such as cuda.
device.def: Where a tensor lives: cpu, or an accelerator such as cuda. Operations need their operands on the same device.

in-place.name: In-place operation
in-place.short: A PyTorch method with a trailing underscore, such as add_, that modifies its tensor's storage instead of returning a new one.
in-place.def: A PyTorch method with a trailing underscore, such as add_, that modifies its tensor's storage instead of returning a new one.

autograd.name: Autograd
autograd.short: PyTorch's mechanism for recording operations on tensors that require gradients and computing derivatives with backward().
autograd.def: PyTorch's mechanism for recording operations on tensors that require gradients and computing derivatives with backward().

gradient.name: Gradient
gradient.short: For a scalar loss, the vector of partial derivatives with respect to each parameter: how much the loss changes per small change in that parameter.
gradient.def: For a scalar loss, the vector of partial derivatives with respect to each parameter: how much the loss changes per small change in that parameter.

requires-grad.name: requires_grad
requires-grad.short: A tensor flag that asks autograd to record operations on it.
requires-grad.def: A tensor flag that asks autograd to record operations on it. Model parameters have it on; cached activations should not.

no-grad.name: no_grad
no-grad.short: A context manager under which operations are not recorded by autograd.
no-grad.def: A context manager under which operations are not recorded by autograd. Use it for every forward pass whose gradients you will not need.

detach.name: detach
detach.short: Return a tensor sharing data with the original but cut off from the autograd graph.
detach.def: Return a tensor sharing data with the original but cut off from the autograd graph.

module.name: nn.Module
module.short: PyTorch's base class for models and layers: a tree of submodules with named parameters and a forward method.
module.def: PyTorch's base class for models and layers: a tree of submodules with named parameters and a forward method.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.short: A tensor registered on a module so that it appears in parameters() and state_dict() and is trained.
parameter.def: A tensor registered on a module so that it appears in parameters() and state_dict() and is trained.

state-dict.name: state_dict
state-dict.short: A dictionary from parameter and buffer names to tensors: the whole learned state of a module, used to save and load weights.
state-dict.def: A dictionary from parameter and buffer names to tensors: the whole learned state of a module, used to save and load weights.

tokenizer.name: Tokenizer
tokenizer.short: Maps text to a sequence of integer token ids and back.
tokenizer.def: Maps text to a sequence of integer token ids and back. GPT-2's byte-pair tokenizer attaches the leading space to the following word.

logits.name: Logits
logits.short: Unnormalised scores for each vocabulary item at each position, shape (batch, seq, vocab).
logits.def: Unnormalised scores for each vocabulary item at each position, shape (batch, seq, vocab). A softmax over the last axis turns them into probabilities.

residual-stream.name: Residual stream
residual-stream.short: The (batch, seq, d_model) tensor that each transformer block reads from and adds to.
residual-stream.def: The (batch, seq, d_model) tensor that each transformer block reads from and adds to. GPT-2 small's d_model is 768.

hidden-states.name: hidden_states
hidden-states.short: The transformers tuple returned by output_hidden_states=True: the embedding output plus one tensor per layer; 13 for GPT-2 small, and the last has the final LayerNorm applied.
hidden-states.def: The transformers tuple returned by output_hidden_states=True: the embedding output plus one tensor per layer; 13 for GPT-2 small, and the last has the final LayerNorm applied.

forward-hook.name: Forward hook
forward-hook.short: A function registered on a module that runs after its forward() with (module, args, output).
forward-hook.def: A function registered on a module that runs after its forward() with (module, args, output). It returns a handle you must remove.

activation-cache.name: Activation cache
activation-cache.short: A dictionary from a name such as blocks.5.hook_resid_post to the tensor captured at that point of the forward pass.
activation-cache.def: A dictionary from a name such as blocks.5.hook_resid_post to the tensor captured at that point of the forward pass.

attention-mask.name: Attention mask
attention-mask.short: A (batch, seq) tensor of ones and zeros marking real tokens versus padding when prompts of different lengths share a batch.
attention-mask.def: A (batch, seq) tensor of ones and zeros marking real tokens versus padding when prompts of different lengths share a batch.

seed.name: Seed
seed.short: The starting state of a pseudo-random generator.
seed.def: The starting state of a pseudo-random generator. The same seed and code give the same draws on the same software and hardware.

safetensors.name: safetensors
safetensors.short: A file format for tensors that stores raw bytes with a JSON header, loads without executing code, and is the Hugging Face default.
safetensors.def: A file format for tensors that stores raw bytes with a JSON header, loads without executing code, and is the Hugging Face default.

manifest.name: Run manifest
manifest.short: A small JSON record of what produced an artifact: model, prompts, seed, versions, and each tensor's shape, dtype and checksum.
manifest.def: A small JSON record of what produced an artifact: model, prompts, seed, versions, and each tensor's shape, dtype and checksum.

eval-pipeline.name: Eval pipeline
eval-pipeline.short: The three practice functions in labs/eval_pipeline.py: score a prediction, load validated cases, and summarise a run without losing failures.
eval-pipeline.def: The three practice functions in labs/eval_pipeline.py: score a prediction, load validated cases, and summarise a run without losing failures.

spec-first.name: Spec first
spec-first.short: Writing the test that states the required behaviour before the implementation, then making it pass.
spec-first.def: Writing the test that states the required behaviour before the implementation, then making it pass.
